You report to the Vice President for the area and work closely with our customers, Product Management and the leadership of the EPR area. Establishing and driving the programme’s governance and acting as the programme’s primary representative towards customer and Systematic management, including preparing and presenting decision papers. Owning the roadmap, schedule, milestones, budget and resource plan, and ensuring proactive risk management with timely escalation to the steering committee. Ensuring delivery in accordance with the agreements and leading changes and negotiations together with our Sales and Legal teams and the Vice President. Managing a complex stakeholder landscape, internally and externally, including customers and their regional top management, political decision-makers, clinical leadership, partners and internal units, and ensuring that the product roadmap is aligned with the programme’s commitments. Building and leading the virtual programme organisation across tracks and departments by setting direction, removing obstacles and being an ambassador for culture and collaboration.
